messages.content: "microcheating" ei concept ta real jinis naki just overreact kora manush der

Eta real concept, kintu subjective o - couple e couple e boundary alada hote pare. Core idea hocche choto choto action jeta explicit cheating na kintu emotional boundary cross kore, jemon secretly kauke follow kora ba flirt kora. Choto lage, but amar mote pattern hole eta boro issue hoye dara - individual instance na.
